name: Major Lewis
summary: A name Larry remembers from flying. On 2026-08-15, at VN-0016, he wrote: "This is major Lewis. We are flying in Aircraft Rosethorn 007." On 2026-09-12, looking at the same photograph, he read another name on the man's helmet and said "Lewis must be somebody else." Both statements are his. No photograph of Major Lewis has been identified.
researchNotes: Hidden from the people index (a template constant) because nothing more is known than the name. Withdrawn from VN-0016 by Larry himself on 2026-09-12 (data/recollections/giscus-vn-0016-c18415765.json). "Lewis must be somebody else" is his inference, not a memory of a second man, so this record is kept: the name came from him, and whether a Lewis flew with his unit is still open (issue #63). Identity notes and the helmet reading: research/people/major-lewis.md. A field-grade aviation officer is comparatively findable once the unit is settled; majors appear in unit histories and flight-operations records. Unlinked 2026-09-14 from giscus-vn-0071-c18307905, which names Rosethorn 007 but not Lewis.
